text.tspan: Patches .caBundle only on labeled CRD/VWC/MWC on shoot.
Owns certs + caBundle only (SSA disjoint field ownership).
Pattern repeats per shoot: one operator Pod per shoot--cp--* namespace (~50 shoots = ~50 instances per operator)
